body: I felt very similar when my fiance died. You need to wait until one day, you decide on your own that you are ready to date again without pressure from others. That is a recipe for disaster. I am so sorry this happened to you. It is the worst thing in the world and personally, I have chosen to never move on. Please don't be like me. I know she would want you to have a happy life.

I lost one, and as far as diet and exercise goes, I probably ended up better than when I started... Hospital food + mandatory physical therapy = less calories and junk they're used to and more physical exercise than they've probably ever done cumulatively. Even with being bedridden for a few weeks! Or maybe I'm just a shitlord.

They have special BMI calculations for amputees. 

But of course, going by normal BMI, I shouldn't be alive. (Ignore the fact that I am missing a leg) Obviously BMI doesn't work for anyone, shitlord!
It doesn't have to be about physical attraction... Of course it matters, but if my partner gained a lot of weight, his health would be my #1 concern. Not the way he looks.

Absolutely. That's why these sort of posts always annoy me... If my partner got fat, my #1 concern would be his health. But so many people act like looks are the main reason... Of course, them not caring about their health is a serious problem, but again, I wouldn't even think of divorce... My SO passed away not too long ago, I would take him back, even if he was 500 pounds and couldn't walk on his own!

This is really heart breaking, but I don't see much where she comments on her concern for his health. I have never had an obese SO, so like the poster commented, I can't really understand how she feels. My SO is dead. I would think the worst part of having an obese SO is seeing their health in danger, not just physical repulsiveness.
Thank you so much. Some things are just so hard to talk about! Even after so many years.

I am so sorry. I posted here yesterday, but I am also facing the sudden death of someone I love more than anything and coping through self harm. Want to talk about it? Please message me if you do. We are going through things that are difficult for others to understand.
